visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: toString(2) Instead of Dividing by Hand
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop divides by 2 and builds the binary text one bit at a time. Use toString(2). The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The standard method is shorter and handles 0 (the loop prints an empty text for it) and every base from 2 to 36.
